targets.query:
from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_base_value" or r._field == "local_hstree_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: HSTree score and SHAP base value

targets.query:
fieldSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"
fieldName = fieldSel
modelName = "hstree"
scalarFields = ["explained_value", "explanation_output", "explanation_error_code", "explained_model", "explainability_mode", "explanation_method", "explanation_profile", "explanation_status", "explainability_seed", "feature_fingerprint", "hstree_anomaly", "hstree_model_fingerprint", "hstree_model_version", "hstree_score", "hstree_status", "hstree_threshold", "local_hstree_score", "iforest_anomaly", "iforest_score", "iforest_status", "iforest_threshold", "local_score", "reference_anomaly", "reference_model", "reference_score", "reference_status", "reference_threshold", "model_version", "model_fingerprint", "shap_background_size", "shap_base_value", "shap_computation_time_ms", "shap_nsamples"]

model_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "explained_model" and r._value == modelName)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"])
    |> group(columns: ["Group"])

shap_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if fieldSel == "ALL" then not contains(value: r._field, set: scalarFields) else r._field == fieldName)
    |> group(columns: ["Group"])

join(tables: {shap: shap_stream, model: model_stream}, on: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: HSTree SHAP contribution of a feature

targets.query:
fieldSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"
groupSel = if "${group}" == "" then "ALL" else "${group}"

ban = ["timestamp","LabviewTime","LabViewTime","StepNumber","Cycle"]

from(bucket: "source-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._field, set: ban))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => fieldSel == "ALL" or r._field == fieldSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => groupSel == "ALL" or r.Group == groupSel)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "explanation_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with status: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["status", "Group"])
  |> count()
  |> group(columns: ["status"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["status"], columnKey: ["Group"], valueColumn: "_value")
  // Collapse the status group key so Grafana receives status as the x field.
  |> group()
  // Keep one row per status and one numeric column per selected group.
  // Grafana renders each group column as a separate coloured series.
  |> sort(columns: ["status"], desc: true)
  |> yield(name: "results_by_status_and_group")

panels.title: How many Explainability V2 HSTree results were produced per selected group?
panels.description: Each bar category is an explanation status, such as warmup or computed. Each colour represents one selected group, so the bar composition shows how many results each group produced in the selected time range. Values are shown on hover.

targets.query:
import "math"

upstream_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "hstree_score")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")

local_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "local_hstree_score")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")

union(tables: [upstream_stream, local_stream])
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.hstree_score and exists r.local_hstree_score)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      identical_scores: if math.abs(x: r.hstree_score - r.local_hstree_score) <= 0.000001 then 1 else 0,
      different_scores: if math.abs(x: r.hstree_score - r.local_hstree_score) > 0.000001 then 1 else 0,
      compared_scores: 1,
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["Group"])
  |> reduce(
      fn: (r, accumulator = {compared_scores: 0, identical_scores: 0, different_scores: 0}) => ({
        compared_scores: accumulator.compared_scores + r.compared_scores,
        identical_scores: accumulator.identical_scores + r.identical_scores,
        different_scores: accumulator.different_scores + r.different_scores,
      }),
      identity: {compared_scores: 0, identical_scores: 0, different_scores: 0},
    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      identical_rate: float(v: r.identical_scores) / float(v: r.compared_scores),
    }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["Group", "compared_scores", "identical_scores", "different_scores", "identical_rate"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Group"])
  |> yield(name: "hstree_score_fidelity_by_group")

panels.title: HSTree score fidelity by group
panels.description: For each selected group, this table counts the scores that are identical or different between upstream HSTree and local Explainability V2. Scores are compared event by event; identical means an absolute difference of at most 0.000001. Warmup events are excluded because one or both scores may be unavailable.

from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_computation_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "shap_time")

from(bucket: "explainability-v2")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability-v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.explained_model or r.explained_model == "hstree")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_computation_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["Group"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "source_event_id"])
  |> movingAverage(n: 100)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "shap_computation_time_ms_ma100"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "shap_time_ma100")
